name: loop-01
title: Core domain: Charges + ChargeInteractions → ForceMagnitude falls out
domain_question: For each pair of charges, what is the electrostatic force magnitude between them?
mock_data_note: Hydrogen atom: proton at origin, electron 1 Bohr radius away. ForceMagnitude = k·|q₁|·|q₂|/r² ≈ 8.24×10⁻⁸ N.
next_suggestion: Ask: what is the direction of the force — and decompose it into X/Y/Z components? That requires ForceComponents.

name: loop-02
title: ForceComponents: decompose force vector into X, Y, Z projections
domain_question: In what direction does each charge push/pull its partner? What are the X, Y, Z force components?
next_suggestion: Ask: what is the electric field at an arbitrary observation point due to a source charge? That requires ElectricFieldPoints.

name: loop-03
title: ElectricFieldPoints: field strength and direction at observation points
domain_question: At any point in space, what is the total electric field due to all charges in the system?
next_suggestion: Ask: which charge dominates the field at each observation point? Add FieldDominantCharge as a derived fact.

name: loop-04
title: SystemSummary: the model witnesses its own state — total force, net field, dominant interactions
domain_question: Across all interactions in this system, what is the total attractive force? Total repulsive force? Which pair has the strongest interaction?
next_suggestion: Add InvariantChecks: Coulomb symmetry (F₁₂ = F₂₁), superposition compliance, sign consistency.
